​Fixed: Corrected a bug where Noclip would occasionally reset after being downed.

​Fixed: Improved the IdentifyExecutor check to prevent script errors on budget executors.

​Fixed: Adjusted the Fly logic to prevent "Rubber-banding" on high-latency servers.

​⚙️ Technical Info

​UI Library: Obsidian UI UI
